cohort_selection.rule: retain the initial 300-source census and all failures, then append user-authorized same-BCSS supplemental candidates in frozen patient/filename order; first fully qualified source per verified patient, requiring both operations and two approved strengths; exclude every technical patient; never select by generated RGB or embedding
cohort_selection.organ: BCSS breast; current canonical annotation-boundary and generic immune-compartment mechanisms
cohort_selection.supplemental_source_rule: same canonical BCSS export and dataset split manifest; append fixed-order supplemental tiers (initial 12 cheap-mask-eligible sources per patient, then all remaining eligible sources if needed); keep prior pools/failures, exclude all technical patients, freeze before formal H&E; not a finalized cohort

route: cross-v1 global reconstruction; no routing/retry-based efficacy estimate

postprocess.eligibility: fixed full-frame mask, content identity shared across paired states, separate from approved joint generation support
postprocess.adaptive_applied_mask: retain per-image alpha mask and hash, nuclei exclusion hash, actual configuration and thresholds; equality of policy name alone is insufficient

sampling.prompt: H&E stained breast cancer histopathology at 40x magnification
sampling.seed_policy: paired states share seed; record effective parameters

base_model.hash_scope: model_index.json and declared component directories, excluding cache metadata

label_space: dataset_config/unified_labels.py: coarse 1 tumor, 2 stroma, 3 necrosis, 4 immune infiltrate; CellViT type 2 inflammatory

evaluation.tumor_primary: coarse tumor pixels / fixed source valid tissue pixels; ignore 0 and 255; fine labels mapped through FINE_TO_PARENT
evaluation.immune_primary: coarse immune-infiltrate pixels / fixed source stromal-or-immune ROI (source parents 2 or 4); not a cell-density endpoint
evaluation.secondary_inflammatory_cell_density: CellViT type 2 centroids inside fixed source stromal-or-immune ROI per mm2 at 0.25 um/px; not interchangeable with compartment fraction
evaluation.target_fidelity: signed and absolute difference from target measured in the same fixed ROI; no binary success threshold
evaluation.protected_roi: source valid tissue outside the union of all pre-generation approved joint semantic changes dilated by 8 pixels; freeze actual mask and hash before generation; empty ROI is not_applicable
evaluation.preservation: protected-ROI coarse-label agreement and RGB mean absolute drift / 255; global reconstruction evidence only
evaluation.ordinal: sham, Moderate, Significant for increasing operations; report continuous paired differences, strict order, ties and reversals; exact pixel-count ties only, no post-result tolerance tuning
evaluation.generation_drift: original vs sham measured separately; never prespecify original<sham
evaluation.missing_policy: no zero imputation; report requested, generated, valid, valid_zero, failure, missing, uncertain, NA, valid pairs; complete-pair analysis plus all-requested bounds for ordinal proportions
evaluation.retry_policy: one technical retry in a new attempt directory with identical input identity; retain both attempts; never retry to improve morphology

roi_validation.u1: pixelwise match to source coarse parent >0, excluding background and ignore
roi_validation.u2: pixelwise match to source coarse parent 2 or 4
roi_validation.protected: source valid tissue minus 8-pixel dilation of four approved handoff J masks, not raw label differences
roi_validation.evidence: cohort_roi_validation.json records denominator count and file/binary mask hashes

ignore_policy.readout: source 255 is ignored; target 255 outside fixed ROI is permitted, inside fixed ROI is invalid
ignore_policy.formal_generation_conditions: must contain only unified known IDs 0..15; HTE has no ignore=255 embedding; resolve unsupported IDs in separately frozen assets before launch, never silently map them to background

statistical_rules.identity_verification: verify TCGA patient prefix against source paths and manifest; one WSI cannot map to multiple patients; reject missing mappings
statistical_rules.all_analyses: patient grouping shared by axis holdout, operation-label permutation, bootstrap, correlation inference, KID and physician analysis
statistical_rules.permutation: raw paired operation label swap for all WSIs of each patient together; refit held-out axes for each swap; exact enumeration when feasible, otherwise 20000 draws
statistical_rules.bootstrap: resample all records of each patient together; 5000 repeats; percentile 95% intervals
statistical_rules.correlation: patient-cluster bootstrap 95% interval for Spearman rho; no ordinary IID pvalue
statistical_rules.multiplicity: four prespecified operation-by-strength edit-minus-sham comparisons form one Holm family at alpha .05; descriptive intervals reported as such; other comparisons exploratory
statistical_rules.physicians: retain reader-specific estimates and patient clustering; allow ties, cannot distinguish and cannot judge; sham-vs-original drift separate
statistical_rules.estimand: equal independent-unit mean; average sources within patient/WSI, then equal-weight units for effect, CI and test

blockers: all three frozen source pools cannot supply 30 patients: 17 nontechnical patients pass source topology, maximum 19 including all unknowns; additional valid same-BCSS source assets or a separately authorized design decision are required; no threshold or endpoint relaxation
formal 30-patient source list, four approved joint targets per source and protected ROI hashes not frozen; initial inputs and expanded censuses are provisional, not qualified cohorts

final-source mapping and training-manifest reference audits must accompany frozen assets; unresolved checkpoint patient lineage is disclosed and automatic readouts remain coupled computational evidence
complete formal-asset preflight on the pinned accepted execution snapshot; revalidate affected technical behavior if the execution implementation changes
historical_analysis_status: corrected inference code tested on synthetic data; historical 2400-image statistics not rerun by this implementation change
technical_pilot_status: complete: 2 real outputs and 3 paired tissue/cell measurement records; stage versions recorded in validation_report.json

joint_budget_definitions.authority: user selected historical 19% / 32% in current chat before new targets and H&E
joint_budget_definitions.interpretation: disjoint planned whole-patch joint-area budgets; actual ROI fraction must rise from source and between strengths by at least .05; no clinical grade interpretation
joint_budget_definitions.gap_scope: check actual Significant-minus-Moderate J separately from the existing fixed-source ROI target dose gap; no post-result mask alteration

implementation_commit_scope: clean execution snapshot accepted for the excluded-source five-state technical chain; formal cohort assets remain unfrozen; rerun affected acceptance if execution code changes

measurement.scale_basis: frozen nominal patch scale; no recovered full-slide physical calibration

source_recovery_audit.status: no additional patient IDs or canonical triplets found; original ROI recovery assets still unresolved

mounted_original_asset_audit.status: original triplets verified; new-crop protocol not frozen, no candidate admitted
